request: Add a returns and exchanges workflow. On any Delivered order, Staff or Manager can record a return or an exchange for specific line items, with a quantity and a reason (Size issue, Damaged, Changed mind, Other). A return puts that variant back in stock and refunds its value; an exchange swaps the item to another size or colour of the same product, checking that the new variant is in stock and adjusting both variants' stock. Show recorded returns and exchanges on the order card. Add a Returns page in the sidebar listing every return and exchange with filters by type and reason. On the dashboard add "Net sales after returns" and a returns count. In Reports, show net sales by category after returns. Save everything in localStorage and include returns in "Reset demo data". Keep every existing feature working exactly as it does now.
steps: Orders: Delivered order cards get a 'Record return or exchange' action for Staff and Manager. It opens a form where you pick a line item, a quantity (limited to what has not already been returned or exchanged), a type (Return or Exchange) and a reason (Size issue, Damaged, Changed mind, Other). Exchanges also ask for another size or colour of the same product, and block the choice if that variant has too little stock.

Stock and refunds: a return adds the quantity back to that variant's stock and records a refund of quantity times the line price. An exchange reduces the new variant's stock and restores the old one's, with no refund. Recorded returns and exchanges are listed on the order card with type, item, quantity, reason and refund.

Returns page: a new 'Returns' sidebar entry for both roles lists every return and exchange with date, order, customer, item, quantity, reason and refund. Filters for type and reason are included, plus a useful empty state when nothing matches.
Dashboard: two new cards, 'Net sales after returns' and a returns count, both derived from stored orders and returns and updating as records change. Existing cards and charts are unchanged.
Reports (Manager only): a new 'Net sales by category after returns' section sits alongside the existing sales by category and top products, deducting refunds from each category.

Persistence: returns are saved in localStorage with the other records, older saved data without returns still loads, and Reset demo data restores the seed returns (a few fictional samples on Delivered orders).
